41398566.patient_population: 1,436 transvaginal ultrasound images for development, 189 external images from a different hospital
41398566.model_description: Transvaginal ultrasound images are input to oriented object-detection models (Oriented RepPoints best among five compared) that localize a standardized oriented cervical canal region for consistent downstream cervical tissue quantification.
41398566.headline_result: Oriented RepPoints achieved average precision 0.981 at IoU 0.5
41398566.study_design: retrospective model development with external validation

41402396.clinical_problem: Streamlining and standardizing fetal MRI analysis to reduce reliance on subspecialized radiological expertise
41402396.model_description: Fetal MRI is input to a web-based AI platform (FetAS) that automates artifact detection, motion correction, segmentation of the fetal body, amniotic fluid and placenta, and classification of fetal/placental position and orientation.

41402791.clinical_problem: Predicting the need for surgery in necrotizing enterocolitis using abdominal X-ray imaging biomarkers
41402791.patient_population: 291 patients (2019-2023), categorized into medical, early surgery, and late surgery groups
41402791.model_description: Color-channel-transformed radiomics features are extracted from the region of interest on abdominal radiographs and screened with t-tests and LASSO regression to identify imaging biomarkers predicting surgical necessity in necrotizing enterocolitis.
41402791.headline_result: Three radiomics features (Blue_variance, a_star_variance, L_star_energy) identified as differential markers for surgical necessity (no AUC reported in abstract)

41406651.exclusion_reason: in vitro synchrotron imaging of bone tissue-engineering scaffolds; non-clinical, not a patient imaging study

41414873.clinical_problem: Estimating developmental brain age from MRI (fetal stage to 2 years) as a biomarker of atypical neurodevelopment
41414873.patient_population: Fetal stage to 2-year-old subjects across reviewed studies and open datasets
41414873.model_description: Systematic review of deep learning approaches that take developmental brain MRI as input and output a predicted 'brain age' (fetal stage to 2 years), compared against chronological age as a biomarker of neurodevelopmental disorders, including review of open-access developmental MRI datasets.

41421500.exclusion_reason: lifespan MRI study of claustrum volume; not pediatric-focused and no clear AI/ML component described
